articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, and Park Outdoor are celebrating Park Outdoor’s 50th digital billboard, a traditional billboard conversion serving travelers moving toward I‑81 just north of Syracuse, New York.
articles.title: Park Outdoor Celebrates 50th Digital Billboard with High-Visibility Upgrade Near Syracuse

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, welcomes Katelyn Smith, athletic director at Adams State University, to the next Women In Sports Online Event scheduled for December 9 at 10:30 a.m. CT.
articles.title: Women In Sports Online Event in December to Focus On Fostering an Environment of Excellence

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, was recently selected by the University of Richmond to manufacture and install 20 LED displays at the Robins Center for Spider Athletics events.
articles.title: University of Richmond Upgrades Robins Center with Daktronics Display System
